summary: Design project results chains, logframe matrices and indicator plans through practical LFA exercises. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Project design using logframes applies the Logical Framework Approach to connect project needs with measurable results. For project officers, programme coordinators, and monitoring specialists, it supports turning a concept into a reviewable design through stakeholder and problem analysis, results-chain development, indicator selection, and planning evidence sources and assumptions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, appraise, or monitor project plans and need to connect proposed activities with measurable results.
modules: LFA Design Logic and Project Scope
Objective Trees and Theory of Change
prerequisites: No prior LFA experience is assumed. Basic familiarity with project objectives, activities, or programme planning will help you apply the exercises to your work.
